name: WORLD_CORE_V09_PACKAGE_CONTINUATION

continuation_rule.condition: The immediately preceding V09 step has an immutable candidate and complete normal-engineering evidence with applicable automated checks passing and no recorded open P0 or MAJOR blocker, and every ADR required at the next step boundary is APPROVED or authoritatively not current for the exact implemented scope.
continuation_rule.effect: The immediately following dependency-ready V09 step may start on codex/world-core-v09 without claiming verification.
continuation_rule.dependency_exception: An IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED dependency is accepted only between adjacent members of the exact allowed_steps sequence.

preserved_controls: V09 steps remain IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED unless independently promoted
normal engineering acceptance, single-writer, determinism, idempotency, architecture, environment, security and governance checks remain mandatory
ADR-03, ADR-17, ADR-18 and ADR-20 are approved architecture for their exact V09 boundaries
ADR-04 remains deferred outside V09 because V09 does not implement its period-input-cycle semantics
real PostgreSQL concurrency and crash evidence uses the ADR-18 disposable local/CI and isolated non-production staging surfaces; PGlite is not the sole evidence surface
V07 Command, Event, Receipt, outbox and replay lineage remain controlling; V08 owns Posting and conservation semantics
candidate DDL remains branch-local until package review and normal promotion; production remains inaccessible
V09 package Review B and delegated-owner promotion remain mandatory before main merge or V10
prohibitions: continue across an unresolved applicable ADR, recorded P0 or MAJOR blocker
merge candidate DDL before V09 package review and delegated-owner promotion authority
merge V09 to main before package Review B and promotion authority
